## Checklist

- [ ] Notebooks are committed **without execution outputs** (`jupyter nbconvert --clear-output --inplace <nb>`)
- [ ] `nbformat.validate` + per-cell syntax check pass locally (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or real API keys added (gitleaks CI enforces this)
- [ ] Markdown is ASCII (no em dashes or smart quotes)
